docs.title: DSS Material
docs.text: Machine-readable Material Design 3 specifications in Design System Spec format.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
DSS Material provides Material Design 3 specifications in a structured, machine-readable format that enables:

  • AI-Assisted Development: LLMs can understand component specs, variants, and accessibility requirements
  • Automated Evaluation: Measure spec completeness and application conformance
  • Cross-Platform Consistency: Platform-agnostic source of truth for all implementations

docs.title: Why DSS?
docs.text:
Official Material Design implementations are in maintenance mode:

Repository Status material-components/material-web Maintenance mode, pending maintainers material-components-android Migrating to Compose material-components-flutter Archived Nov 2023 material-components-ios Archived Dec 2025

DSS Material provides a platform-agnostic specification that:

  1. Preserves detailed component documentation
  2. Enables AI agents to generate compliant implementations
  3. Supports automated quality evaluation
  4. Works across all platforms and frameworks

docs.title: Go Library
docs.text: go get github.com/plexusone/dss-material

docs.title: MCP Server for Claude
docs.text:
go install github.com/plexusone/dss-material/cmd/dss-material-mcp@latest

Configure in Claude Desktop:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "material-design": {
      "command": "dss-material-mcp",
      "args": ["--version", "v3"]
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Spec Structure
docs.text:
specs/v3/
├── meta.json           # Version, description
├── accessibility.json  # Global a11y requirements
├── foundations/
│   ├── colors.json     # Dynamic color system
│   ├── typography.json # Type scale
│   ├── spacing.json    # Spacing tokens
│   └── elevation.json  # Shadow definitions
└── components/
    ├── button.json     # 5 variants
    ├── textfield.json  # filled, outlined
    ├── dialog.json
    └── ...             # 23 components

docs.title: Claude Desktop Setup
docs.text: Complete guide to setting up DSS Material with Claude Desktop.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Claude Desktop installed
  • Go 1.21+ (for installing MCP server)
  • Terminal access

docs.title: Step 1: Install MCP Server
docs.text:
go install github.com/plexusone/dss-material/cmd/dss-material-mcp@latest

Verify it's in your PATH:

which dss-material-mcp

If not found, add $GOPATH/bin to your PATH:

export PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin"

docs.title: Locate Config File
docs.text: OS Path macOS ~/.claude/claude_desktop_config.json Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json Linux ~/.config/claude/claude_desktop_config.json

docs.title: Add MCP Server
docs.text:
Edit the config file:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "material-design": {
      "command": "dss-material-mcp",
      "args": ["--version", "v3"]
    }
  }
}

Multiple Servers

You can add multiple MCP servers. Each server name must be unique:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "material-design": {
      "command": "dss-material-mcp",
      "args": ["--version", "v3"]
    },
    "other-server": {
      "command": "other-mcp-server"
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Step 3: Restart Claude Desktop
docs.text:
1. Quit Claude Desktop completely
  2. Reopen Claude Desktop
  3. The MCP server should now be available

docs.title: Step 4: Verify Setup
docs.text:
Start a new conversation and ask:

"What Material Design components are available?"

If working correctly, Claude will use the dss_list_components tool.

docs.title: Component Specifications
docs.text:
Ask about any Material Design component:

  • "How do I implement a filled button?"
  • "What variants does the card component have?"
  • "Show me the text field properties"

docs.title: Design Tokens
docs.text:
Query design tokens:

  • "What's the primary color?"
  • "Show me the typography scale"
  • "What are the elevation levels?"

docs.title: Accessibility
docs.text:
Check accessibility requirements:

  • "What are the keyboard shortcuts for buttons?"
  • "What ARIA attributes do I need for a dialog?"
  • "How should I handle focus in a modal?"

docs.title: Anti-Patterns
docs.text:
Avoid common mistakes:

  • "What are button anti-patterns?"
  • "What should I avoid when implementing cards?"

docs.title: Building a Form
docs.text:
"I need to build a login form with Material Design. What components should I use and what are their specs?"

Claude will:

  1. Suggest TextField, Button components
  2. Provide specifications for each
  3. Include accessibility requirements
  4. Warn about anti-patterns

docs.title: Theming
docs.text:
"I want to create a custom Material theme. What tokens do I need to customize?"

Claude will:

  1. List color tokens
  2. Explain dynamic color system
  3. Provide token values for reference

docs.title: Code Review
docs.text:
"Review this button implementation for Material Design compliance: [code]"

Claude will:

  1. Check against component specification
  2. Verify accessibility requirements
  3. Identify anti-patterns
  4. Suggest improvements

docs.title: "Tools not available"
docs.text:
1. Check config JSON syntax
  2. Verify server is installed: which dss-material-mcp
  3. Restart Claude Desktop
  4. Check logs: ~/.claude/logs/mcp.log

docs.title: "Server connection failed"
docs.text:
1. Test server standalone: dss-material-mcp --version v3
  2. Check for port conflicts
  3. Ensure Go binary is executable

docs.title: "Unknown component"
docs.text: The component may not be in the spec yet. Check the Spec Viewer for available components.

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:

  • Check Evaluation Dashboard for spec completeness

docs.title: MCP Server Integration
docs.text: Use the DSS Material MCP server with Claude Desktop for AI-assisted Material Design implementation.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The dss-material-mcp server provides Claude with access to Material Design 3 specifications, enabling:

  • Component specification lookup
  • Accessibility requirement checks
  • Design token queries
  • Implementation guidance

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Go 1.21 or later
  • Claude Desktop

docs.title: Install the Server
docs.text:
go install github.com/plexusone/dss-material/cmd/dss-material-mcp@latest

Verify installation:

dss-material-mcp --version

docs.title: Claude Desktop Setup
docs.text:
Add to your Claude Desktop configuration (~/.claude/claude_desktop_config.json):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "material-design": {
      "command": "dss-material-mcp",
      "args": ["--version", "v3"]
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Configuration Options
docs.text: Flag Default Description --version v3 Material Design version (v3 or v4) --verbose false Enable verbose logging

docs.title: Available Tools
docs.text: Once configured, Claude has access to these tools:

docs.title: dss_get_component
docs.text:
Get full specification for a component.

dss_get_component(id: "button")

Returns:

  • Variants
  • Properties
  • Events
  • Slots
  • Accessibility requirements
  • LLM context (anti-patterns, examples)

docs.title: dss_list_components
docs.text:
List all available components.

dss_list_components()

docs.title: dss_get_token
docs.text:
Get a design token value.

dss_get_token(category: "colors", id: "md-sys-color-primary")

docs.title: dss_get_accessibility
docs.text:
Get accessibility requirements for a component.

dss_get_accessibility(component: "button")

docs.title: dss_get_anti_patterns
docs.text:
Get anti-patterns to avoid for a component.

dss_get_anti_patterns(component: "button")

docs.title: Ask Claude About Components
docs.text:
"How should I implement a Material Design button?"

Claude will use dss_get_component("button") to provide accurate specifications.

docs.title: Check Accessibility
docs.text:
"What are the accessibility requirements for a dialog?"

Claude will use dss_get_accessibility("dialog") to list WCAG requirements.

docs.title: Get Design Tokens
docs.text:
"What's the primary color in Material Design 3?"

Claude will query dss_get_token("colors", "md-sys-color-primary").

docs.title: Server Not Starting
docs.text:
Check the server runs standalone:

dss-material-mcp --version v3
# Should output: dss-material-mcp version X.Y.Z

docs.title: Tools Not Available
docs.text:
Ensure Claude Desktop configuration is correct:

  1. Check JSON syntax in config file
  2. Restart Claude Desktop
  3. Check logs: ~/.claude/logs/

docs.title: Debug Mode
docs.text:
Run with verbose logging:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "material-design": {
      "command": "dss-material-mcp",
      "args": ["--version", "v3", "--verbose"]
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Be specific - Ask about specific components or tokens
  2. Reference versions - Mention "Material Design 3" for clarity
  3. Check anti-patterns - Ask Claude to check for anti-patterns
  4. Verify accessibility - Always confirm a11y requirements
